entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:1
segments: ¶"Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep His charge, His statutes, His judgments, and His commandments always.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:2
segments: "Know today that [I do] not [speak] with your children, who have not known and who have not seen the chastening of the LORD your God, His greatness and His mighty hand and His outstretched arm-

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:3
segments: "His signs and His acts which He did in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to all his land;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:4
segments: "what He did to the army of Egypt, to their horses and their chariots: how He made the waters of the Red Sea overflow them as they pursued you, and [how] the LORD has destroyed them to this day;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:5
segments: "what He did for you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:6
segments: "and what He did to Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, their households, their tents, and all the substance that [was] in their possession, in the midst of all Israel-

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:7
segments: "but your eyes have seen every great act of the LORD which He did.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:8
segments: ¶"Therefore you shall keep every commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land which you cross over to possess,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:9
segments: "and that you may prolong [your] days in the land which the LORD swore to give your fathers, to them and their descendants, 'a land flowing with milk and honey.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:10
segments: "For the land which you go to possess [is] not like the land of Egypt from which you have come, where you sowed your seed and watered [it] by foot, as a vegetable garden;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:11
segments: "but the land which you cross over to possess [is] a land of hills and valleys, which drinks water from the rain of heaven,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:12
segments: "a land for which the LORD your God cares; the eyes of the LORD your God [are] always on it, from the beginning of the year to the very end of the year.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:13
segments: 'And it shall be that if you earnestly obey My commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God and serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:14
segments: 'then I will give [you] the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:15
segments: 'And I will send grass in your fields for your livestock, that you may eat and be filled.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:16
segments: "Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other gods and worship them,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:17
segments: "lest the LORD'S anger be aroused against you, and He shut up the heavens so that there be no rain, and the land yield no produce, and you perish quickly from the good land which the LORD is giving you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:18
segments: ¶"Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul, and bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:19
segments: "You shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:20
segments: "And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:21
segments: "that your days and the days of your children may be multiplied in the land of which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, like the days of the heavens above the earth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:22
segments: "For if you carefully keep all these commandments which I command you to do-to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him-

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:23
segments: "then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you will dispossess greater and mightier nations than yourselves.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:24
segments: "Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the River Euphrates, even to the Western Sea, shall be your territory.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:25
segments: "No man shall be able to stand against you; the LORD your God will put the dread of you and the fear of you upon all the land where you tread, just as He has said to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:26
segments: ¶"Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:27
segments: "the blessing, if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:28
segments: "and the curse, if you do not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside from the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:29
segments: "Now it shall be, when the LORD your God has brought you into the land which you go to possess, that you shall put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:30
segments: "[Are] they not on the other side of the Jordan, toward the setting sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the plain opposite Gilgal, beside the terebinth trees of Moreh?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:31
segments: "For you will cross over the Jordan and go in to possess the land which the LORD your God is giving you, and you will possess it and dwell in it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:32
segments: "And you shall be careful to observe all the statutes and judgments which I set before you today.
